js: (async () => { const m = await import('/v5/js/world/mainland/plan.js'); window.__plan = m; const g=window.__game; const D=g.daynight; if (D && D.setHour) D.setHour(13); const pick = (k, d) => m.M_BLOCKS.find(b => b.kind === k && (!d || b.district === d)); const hb = pick('calle'); const tb = pick('towers', 'downtown'); const vb = pick('houses'); const ab = pick('apartments') || pick('bungalows'); window.__B = { hb, tb, vb, ab }; g.world.mainland.fill({x:hb.cx, z:hb.cz}, 30000); g.player.spawn(hb.rect.x1 + 2.6, hb.cz + 10, Math.PI); g.camRig.yaw = Math.PI; g.camRig.pitch = 0.04; return { hb: [hb.col, hb.row, hb.kind], tb: tb && [tb.col, tb.row], vb: vb && [vb.col, vb.row], ab: ab && [ab.col, ab.row, ab.kind] }; })()

(async () => { const m = window.__plan; const g=window.__game; const pl = m.PLACES.find(q => q.id === 'galleria'); const b = m.placeBlock(pl); g.world.mainland.fill({x:b.cx, z:b.cz}, 30000); const mall = g.world.malls.find(x=>/galleria/i.test(x.name)); const s = mall.stores.find(s=>s.kind==='fashion') || mall.stores[0]; const R = s.room; const c = R.center; const fx = R.facade.nx, fz = R.facade.nz; g.player.spawn(c.x + fx*1.6, c.z + fz*1.6, Math.atan2(-fx, -fz)); g.camRig.yaw = Math.atan2(-fx, -fz) + 0.25; g.camRig.pitch = 0.05; window.__mall = mall; return s.kind + ':' + s.name; })()

(() => { const g=window.__game; const mall = window.__mall; const s = mall.stores.find(s=>s.kind==='electronics') || mall.stores[2]; const R = s.room; const c = R.center; const fx = R.facade.nx, fz = R.facade.nz; g.player.spawn(c.x + fx*1.6, c.z + fz*1.6, Math.atan2(-fx, -fz)); g.camRig.yaw = Math.atan2(-fx, -fz) - 0.25; g.camRig.pitch = 0.05; return s.kind + ':' + s.name; })()
(() => { const g=window.__game; const mall = window.__mall; const h = mall.hall; g.player.spawn((h.x0+h.x1)/2, h.z0 + 8, 0); g.camRig.yaw = 0; g.camRig.pitch = 0.1; return null; })()
